# Callbassador
> Done-for-you AI receptionist for home-service businesses (plumbers, HVAC, electricians, roofers, landscapers & lawn care, tree services, painters, general contractors & remodelers, handymen, pest control, cleaning companies (residential & commercial cleaning, maid services, janitorial), garage door, pool & spa, gutters, flooring, pressure washing, snow removal, junk removal, movers) across the United States (set up remotely). Operated by Callbassador LLC, 64 E Uwchlan Ave, Suite 241, Exton, PA 19341. Tagline: "Catch every call. Catch every job."

## What it does
- Answers inbound calls and texts 24/7, answers FAQs, flags emergencies, takes the caller's details and texts the owner a summary. Appointment booking (Google Calendar; Jobber planned) is on Pro and Crew plans only.
- Inbound only: never makes outbound sales calls or robocalls.
- Every call opens with a recording notice (all-party-consent compliance).
- Setup is done for the business, usually within 24-48 hours; they forward calls to their Callbassador number.

## Pricing (USD/month)
- Starter $79: 150 minutes
- Pro $149: 400 minutes + booking
- Crew $249: 800 minutes
- November Special (November Onboarding): Grab one of 10 onboarding spots for November now (white-glove custom setup capped at 10 new shops/month; 10 of 10 November onboarding spots open) — Pro at $99/mo locked for 12 months (normally $149/mo). 14-day free trial, free custom setup, no credit card required to start, cancel anytime. Start 14-day free trial: https://callbassador.com/#demo
- 14-day free trial + free custom setup (no credit card required to start) and free live custom demo; no contracts.

## Best for
Small (1-20 person) home-service businesses of any trade across the United States that miss calls while on jobs.
